nodes.label: initiator_form.html (Initiator Factor A Form)
nodes.rationale: Edits the initiator factor A of an assessment. Shows the risk's initiator boundary (initiator, count unit, scope, count exclusions) and warns when the risk is incomplete: A is saved but cannot be finally approved (Section 13). Shows the rate-based level suggestion and the reasons data is insufficient, next to the A scale table (Section 14).

nodes.label: Initiator frequency scale A (Section 14)
nodes.rationale: A is graded by annual rate or forward-looking evidence. The chosen route and its rationale are required, and the two columns are never summed or averaged. Zero events in one year does not prove a rate below 0.1. With insufficient data A is recorded as 'Unknown' or forward-looking evidence is reviewed. An incomplete risk definition blocks final approval of A (Section 13).
